headline: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
summary: Google updated its Gemini app for Mac with computer-use abilities, letting it organize files, fill out forms, tackle multistep workflows and even list items for sale such as on eBay. Gemini's separate Task mode can also coordinate calls, log into websites and make purchases on a user's behalf.

claims.statement: Google gave the Gemini app for Mac the ability to use your computer for multistep tasks.
